summary: Tested public backend APIs and the full Q&A, citation modal, source library, dashboard, and responsive UI flows.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText rejection is unhandled; browser permission denial produces an uncaught runtime error overlay and blocks modal controls.

integration_issues.issue: Selecting BNSS leaves all 8 cards visible. LibraryPage calls filterLibrary with the previous scope immediately after setScope, so the request uses stale category state.

action_items: Handle clipboard permission/API rejection in copy() with a caught promise and user-facing fallback or error toast; do not allow an uncaught overlay.
Fix library category selection to request with the newly selected category rather than stale scope state.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API calls use the configured REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly.
Backend uses deterministic in-memory SOURCES and HISTORY; this is intentionally MOCKED and is not persistent across process restarts.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing seeded legal corpus.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints passed health, corpus search/detail, validation, scoped query, and analytics checks. Q&A and citation modal work unless a copy action rejects; library search works, but category filtering is broken. Dashboard and responsive checks were not reached after the confirmed category failure.
rca of the issue: Copy failure: copy() invokes navigator.clipboard.writeText(text) without await/catch, so NotAllowedError becomes an uncaught promise rejection and CRA's runtime overlay intercepts clicks. Category failure: LibraryPage's onChange executes setScope(e.target.value) and filterLibrary(search); filterLibrary closes over the old scope and sends it as the category query parameter.
